question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Shiva to Avici.
This range covers the full cosmic spectrum.
inference: One should meditate on that object in every place as pervading all levels from Shiva down to Avici.
